'''Jason Foss Ominous Rumors''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Jason Foss]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-10108">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/10108 Ominous Rumors], DeckTech (Jason "jade" Foss, 2 September 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/10108/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/10108/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018125335/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/10108/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Jason Foss]]
* '''Published:''' 2 September 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Ominous Rumors''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif|label=Endor Operations}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 EOps Foss DS 2000 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' Endor Operations deck that does't flip and just drains in space.

== Original post ==

'''Ominous Rumors'''
* '''Author:''' Jason "jade" Foss
* '''Published:''' September 2, 2000
* '''Rating:''' 3.5
* '''Description:''' Endor Operations deck that does't flip and just drains in space.

=== Strategy ===

Basicaly Just Get rumors going and drain your opponet to death.
